correction: Earlier keyword search missed existing design-preparation records because the canonical material is stored in structured JSON and the old planning matrix still contains obsolete DawnBookshop wording. These records are reusable as editorial definitions, but their placement must be updated to the newer site-first architecture.
sharedRule: 三晨星、光譜、策展集 are editorial/discovery standards over canonical content identities. They are not tools, not mutually exclusive categories, and not independent content owners.

threeMorningStars.question: 什麼值得被特別留下、推薦與再次看見？
threeMorningStars.core: highest-intensity editorial judgement; not popularity, traffic ranking or star rating
threeMorningStars.libraryProjection: same judgement filtered to Dawn Library canonical Works; no duplicate system

spectrum.question: 這些內容與知識彼此是什麼關係？
spectrum.core: relational knowledge/discovery structure; not a ranking and not a filter panel
spectrum.siteProjection: first-layer view across eligible site content
spectrum.libraryProjection: may reveal Works but does not live as a permanent Library mode
spectrum.jerusalem3000: a content work/periodical project positioned through Spectrum; never a standalone Spectrum section or tool

curatedSets.question: 這些內容應該怎樣被組合、閱讀與使用？
curatedSets.siteProjection: first-layer editorial grouping that may cross Magazine, Cinema, Dawn Library, Church and other eligible content
curatedSets.libraryProjection: book members hand off to canonical Work reader; the set itself remains site-level

relationship: One canonical content object may simultaneously have Spectrum coordinates, belong to multiple curated sets, and receive Three Morning Stars selection. These layers never duplicate the underlying object.

supersede: placing all three layers primarily inside Dawn Library
treating selection standards as a Dawn-only concern
migration.keepLibrarySpecific: Three Morning Stars retains a Dawn Library projection because it is directly useful for selecting a Work.

designConsequence: Later layout exploration must design these as three different editorial gestures, not three equal tabs: Three Morning Stars = sparse emphasis; Spectrum = relational field/continuum; Curated Sets = composed sequence/path. All must share the site's modern editorial language.
next: Build first real data specimens for each layer from existing canonical content, then test whether the contracts are sufficient before layout work.
